Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Scott et al. (2001), cementite BM3

**close** · `cementite_scott_2001_bm3_1` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/cementite.md#record-cementite_scott_2001_bm3_1)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Qualified similarity of a digitized, equal-weight reconstruction. Both free central coefficients lie outside their printed source error widths; the broad combined-error screen does not establish coefficient parity.

- Scott et al. (2001), page 1876 and Figure 3, report weighted least squares on observations from two runs. Only 21 digitized filled-symbol observations are available here; the open temperature-quenched point is excluded. Incomplete digitized coordinate error bars cause the generic row reader to omit both sigma arrays, so this reconstruction uses equal pressure weights. Its retained errors use residual-scaled covariance because no observation sigmas are supplied, even though the generic ledger records absolute\_sigma=True. They are not recovered source weights or a source confidence interval. The original row array, run identities, weights, covariance and precise objective remain unavailable. The source coefficients and digitization are preserved; this finding does not show that the published EOS is incorrect.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** cementite\_scott\_2001\_figure3\_digitized
- **Observations:** 21
- **Fit kind:** isothermal\_pv
- **Selection:** all rows
- **Objective:** pressure\_residuals
- **Weighting:** Equal pressure weights; incomplete plotted errors are not used as fit sigmas. Refit covariance is scaled by residual variance.
- **Absolute sigma:** True
- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** V0

## Prescher et al. (2012), full-range BM3 (adopted V0)

**reproduced** · `cementite_prescher_2012_full_range_bm3` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/cementite.md#record-cementite_prescher_2012_full_range_bm3)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Conditional agreement of K0 and K0\_prime at published printed precision for the 19 numbered p1-p19 observations, with adopted curve-derived V0 held fixed. K0 uncertainty is not reproduced: 2.532193 GPa rounds to 3, while the published error is 2 GPa.

- Conditional coefficient parity compares K0 and K0\_prime at the published printed precision, with adopted V0=154.5678863704812 A^3 per conventional Fe3C cell (Z=4) held fixed. Published K0=161 +/-2 GPa and K0\_prime=5.9 +/-0.2 are retained unchanged. V0 is adopted from the published calculated full-range curve, not a printed source coefficient or the ambient measurement. Its uncertainty and the original fixed/free V0 convention are unrecovered. Numerical coefficient agreement does not establish uncertainty agreement, author-workflow reproduction or physical validation.
- The primary experimental dataset is all 19 numbered p1-p19 points from final Table S1, with published ruby pressures and reported widths, spanning 1.8-47.4 GPa at nominal 293 K. The recorded comparison uses equal pressure weights with V0 fixed and K0/K0\_prime free. It gives K0=160.994011 +/-2.532193 GPa and K0\_prime=5.919478 +/-0.240867, displayed as 161 +/-3 and 5.9 +/-0.2 at the paper precision. The K0 uncertainty is not reproduced: 2.532193 GPa rounds to 3, not the published 2 GPa. Covariance is inverse(J^T J)\*SSE/(19-2), conditional on exact V0 and exact input volumes. Source coordinate widths are preserved but are not the weights in this comparison; source confidence and calibration covariance are unknown. The 22 digitized Figure 1 markers remain separate supplementary evidence, not the primary dataset. No ambient or p20-p22 point is added. For p16, the final source volume is 133.25 A^3, not the alternate SHELX cell 133.58 A^3. Published split fits remain audit-only.
- This is a conditional coefficient comparison, not recovery of source confidence, calibration covariance or the author fitting workflow.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** cementite\_prescher\_2012\_table\_s1
- **Observations:** 19
- **Fit kind:** isothermal\_pv
- **Selection:** All 19 numbered p1-p19 final Table S1 rows; no ambient point
- **Objective:** pressure\_residuals
- **Weighting:** Equal pressure weights; reported coordinate widths retained but not used as weights
- **Absolute sigma:** False
- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** V0
- **Fixed values:**
    - **V0:** 154.568

## Li et al. (2002), 300 K BM3

**reproduced** · `cementite_li_2002_bm3` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/cementite.md#record-cementite_li_2002_bm3)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Agreement within the source's reported parameter error widths; this is not an inferred confidence convention.

- Conditional parameter parity compares K0 and K0\_prime within the printed source error widths using all 12 nonambient Table 1 observations. Measured V0=155.28(11) A^3 per conventional Pnma Fe3C cell (Z=4) is fixed as in the source, not independently recovered by the fit. Published errors have unspecified confidence. The diagnostic effective-variance objective treats printed pressure and volume widths as if independent standard errors; its unscaled inverse-JtJ covariance is conditional. Original residual direction, weights, covariance, confidence convention and fit project are unavailable. Fixed-V0 uncertainty and shared calibration errors are not propagated. Original ruby wavelengths and separate ruby/neon pressure arrays are missing, so the pressure averaging cannot be replayed. Original-scale published coefficients and observations are preserved; Litasov (2013) recalibrated comparison coefficients are not substituted. This is not author-workflow reproduction, magnetic-phase validation or a recommendation for extrapolation.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** cementite\_li\_2002\_table1
- **Observations:** 12
- **Fit kind:** isothermal\_pv
- **Selection:** Table 1 rows 3-14; reference-card row 1 excluded; measured ambient row 2 supplies fixed V0 only
- **Objective:** effective\_variance\_pressure\_residuals
- **Weighting:** rP/sqrt(sP^2+(dP/dV\*sV)^2), parameter-dependent, with printed widths conditionally treated as independent standard errors; no log-variance term
- **Absolute sigma:** True
- **Free parameters:** K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** V0
- **Fixed values:**
    - **V0:** 155.28

## Ono and Mibe (2010), original experimental 300 K BM3, below 35 GPa

**untested** (source calculation reconstructed) · `cementite_ono_mibe_2010_bm3` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/cementite.md#record-cementite_ono_mibe_2010_bm3)

**Warning:** Qualified use only; see the audit. Fitted only to 34.3 GPa at 300 K; the V0 constraint, fit weights and coefficient errors are not reported.

**Scope:** Reconstruction of a source equation or calculation. **Basis:** Source-equation parity against identified graphical checkpoints within declared reading and printed-coefficient bounds; no independent parameter refit or author-workflow reproduction.

- Original experimental BM3 at 300 K, restricted to the below-35-GPa fit (last measured fit point 34.3 GPa). V0=155.4(2) A^3 is adopted from the measured Table 1 ambient cell and checked against Figure 4; the paper does not explicitly state its V0 fitting constraint. K0=167 GPa and K0\_prime=6.7 are the original Table 3 values, without reported coefficient errors. Source-equation agreement is checked at graphical resolution; the separate fixed-anchor equal-pressure refit is diagnostic, not coefficient parity or recovery of author weights. Original pressures and all 14 measurements are preserved. No Litasov recalibration, 0 K DFT branch, high-pressure magnetic transition model or thermal extrapolation is substituted. Use original experimental curve within 300 K and 0-34.3 GPa; ambient anchor adoption and unavailable author fit details remain explicit.
- Use original experimental curve within 300 K and 0-34.3 GPa; ambient anchor adoption and unavailable author fit details remain explicit.
- Usage recommendation: qualified\_use
- Original V0 fitting constraint, objective, weights, coefficient errors and covariance are not reported.
- NaCl readings needed for a fit-domain pressure recalculation are not supplied.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** cementite\_ono\_mibe\_2010\_table1
- **Observations:** 5
- **Fit kind:** source\_curve\_validation\_only
